property.text: After upgrade_to_fulu: post.fork.current_version == FULU_FORK_VERSION. The post-state MUST have the correct Fulu fork version.

reachability.notes: Wrong fork version causes complete P2P network isolation.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect fork version causes node to operate on incompatible protocol version, effectively forking off the network.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires demonstrating wrong fork version after upgrade.

property.text: After upgrade_to_fulu: post.fork.epoch == get_current_epoch(pre). The fork epoch recorded in state MUST match the epoch at which the fork was triggered.

reachability.notes: Incorrect fork epoch in state would affect epoch-dependent logic.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect fork epoch could affect downstream epoch-dependent computations.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing fork epoch mismatch in post-state.

property.text: After upgrade_to_fulu: post.proposer_lookahead == initialize_proposer_lookahead(pre). The new Fulu field (EIP-7917) MUST be freshly initialized from the pre-state.
property.severity_justification: Incorrect proposer_lookahead would cause wrong proposer assignments, enabling unauthorized block proposals.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires demonstrating incorrect proposer assignment from bad lookahead initialization.

property.text: upgrade_to_fulu is a pure function: it MUST NOT produce side effects on the pre-state. The pre-state MUST remain unchanged after calling upgrade_to_fulu.

reachability.notes: Pre-state mutation would cause non-deterministic behavior but is hard to exploit externally.

property.severity_justification: Pre-state mutation during fork would cause non-deterministic state transitions, potentially causing consensus splits.

property.text: Fork epoch constants MUST be strictly ordered: GENESIS_FORK_EPOCH < ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH < BELLATRIX_FORK_EPOCH < CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH < DENEB_FORK_EPOCH < ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH < FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

reachability.notes: Fork epoch ordering is critical for compute_fork_version correctness. Reachable via P2P fork digest computation.

property.severity_justification: Violated ordering would cause compute_fork_version to return wrong fork version, causing network-wide P2P partition.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires demonstrating misordered fork constants causing consensus divergence.

property.text: compute_fork_version MUST take exactly one branch for any valid epoch value. No two branches may be taken simultaneously, and there MUST be no epoch value for which no branch is taken.

reachability.notes: Used in fork digest computation for P2P topic subscription.

property.severity_justification: Ambiguous fork version selection would cause P2P network fragmentation.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires demonstrating epoch value that causes wrong or ambiguous fork version.

property.text: compute_fork_version MUST always return a valid Version (4-byte fork version). The function MUST NOT return an error, null, or undefined value for any epoch >= 0.

reachability.notes: A null fork version would crash P2P message handling.

property.severity_justification: Null or invalid return would crash node during P2P handshake or gossip validation.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC with edge-case epoch causing function failure.

property.text: verify_data_column_sidecar MUST reject any sidecar where sidecar.index >= NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS. The column index MUST be in range [0, NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS).

reachability.notes: An attacker can craft a sidecar with an out-of-range index and send it via P2P gossip.

property.severity_justification: Accepting out-of-range column index could cause array out-of-bounds access, node crash, or data corruption.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing sidecar with index >= NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS bypassing validation.

property.text: verify_data_column_sidecar MUST reject any sidecar where kzg_commitments is empty (len(sidecar.kzg_commitments) == 0).

reachability.notes: Attacker can craft sidecar with empty commitments and send via gossip.

property.severity_justification: Empty commitments sidecar could cause division-by-zero or unexpected behavior in downstream processing.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing empty-commitment sidecar bypassing validation.

property.text: verify_data_column_sidecar MUST reject any sidecar where len(kzg_commitments) > get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block for the epoch derived from the sidecar's slot.

reachability.notes: Attacker can craft sidecar with excessive commitments. The epoch-dependent limit adds complexity.

property.severity_justification: Accepting excess commitments could cause excessive memory allocation, node crash, or consensus divergence if max_blobs_per_block differs between clients.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Especially interesting at epoch boundaries where blob parameters change.
